about: 2026-11-15 (gameplayfix, item 12): the Nitro Royal Rumble crash -- a model with WrestleMania 2000-style hands in slot 6 or past it, after the hands' pictures were first loaded in a match with six slots (wm_keep copied a palette to address 0). Two Rumbles: the first with 6 in the ring at once (qa_rr_ring_first), the second with 10; every entrant a wrestler from a folder (qa_rr_folders: the Revenge and WrestleMania 2000 imports have WrestleMania 2000-style hands -- the crashes' slots 6 and 8 held such Revenge imports), one every 10 s. Before the fix (mod/src/hands.c): CRASH in the second Rumble once such a model takes slot 6..9. After: PASS

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: the second Rumble has room for 10 (its slot count)
seven or more in the ring at once (slots 6.. used)
no model's matrices ever went bad
